startTitle: Assalamu'alaikum — I made a little something for you…
startHint: 🎧 Put on your headphones and turn the sound up for the best experience, InshaAllah.
name: you
greetingText: Alhamdulillah, how blessed am I to have met someone as wonderful and kind-hearted as you.
text1: Alhamdulillah for another blessed year of your life! 🌙
textInChatBox: Barakallahu fi umrik! May Allah bless your days with endless barakah, sakinah, and happiness…
text2: That was what I was going to send.
text3: But then I paused and thought for a while.
text4: I realised I wanted to make a Du'a and gift that felt
text5Content: you are such a blessing from Allah
wishText: May Allah (SWT) bless your new age with endless barakah, sakinah, good health, and happiness in both Dunya and Akhirah.
cakePrompt: 🏮 Click the lantern above to illuminate it with Noor & reveal your secret Du'a letter!
cakeWishGranted: 🤲 Aamiin Ya Rabbal 'Alamin! Here is your secret Du'a letter…
letterBody: Alhamdulillah for another year of your life. I pray that Allah (SWT) grants you health, steadfastness in Iman, endless barakah in your rizq, and surrounds you with people who love you for His sake. May He answer every silent Du'a in your heart and grant you the highest level of Jannah. Aamiin Ya Rabbal 'Alamin.
outroText: JazakAllah Khair — I hope this little surprise brought a smile to your heart.
replayText: Tap here to replay from the beginning, InshaAllah
